text_block_list.text:
Today's the day our training begins! I'm so
glad to work with youuu!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: Same here! Let's start out strong!

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'll put my all into whatever you
throw at me! Just tell me what
to do!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, you wanted to talk before
practice, right? What is it? What
should
we talk about?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Before starting formal training, I need to
properly understand the
racer and her
abilities.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All the Umamusume without trainers were
drilled by academy
instructors, and
according to the notes they gave me...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
You're constantly rushing during races, aren't
you?

text_block_list.text:
Aaah! I get that a lot! But I have a hard
time keeping it cool...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume gets heated up in a
race, don't they? I get caught
up in the
energy—that feeling of, like, "waaagh!" I
can't help it.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
My instructor at the academy used to say,
"You lay your emotions
completely bare."
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Is that really true though? I always thought
that was pretty normal.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: You know the story 60,000 Furlongs in Search of Mother?

text_block_list.text:
The story about Umako?! Yeah, yeah! I
know it! I saw the anime! I
even read the
book in school!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
What a great story, riiight?! The first
episode where Umako finds the
little girl's
lost carrot was so... touching!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ug... Hic... Umako! Such a kind child! Waaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: You really do lay everything bare!

text_block_list.text: Say whaaat?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
This extreme earnestness might really be
Уиннинг Тикит's weakness.
Still—
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! You okay?! Did you get lost
in your own head?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, wait... Is how I'm behaving
really bad?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh nooooo! How could I annoy you like
this? I'm useless... I'm the
wooorst!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: There's nothing wrong with your behavior.

text_block_list.text: Really?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But even during tryouts, I got overexcited
and ended up in fifth...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
Someday, that personality of yours is going to
be a powerful weapon.

text_block_list.text: You mean it?! A weapon... Yeah... Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
If she can remember to let loose at just the
right time, her earnest
attitude will be her
greatest weapon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So what she needs to focus on now is
judging when that right moment
is. She has
to run according to a plan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Okay, Ticket, here's what you need to do!

text_block_list.text: Whoooah! What, what, what?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: Study like you've never studied before!

text_block_list.text: I have to... study?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Guhyaaagh! You gotta be kidding meeeee!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Thus begins my days of arduous training
with Уиннинг Тикит.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaagh! Phew!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: How was that, Тренер? I ran at full speed!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
Well, we're working on your pace, so
maintaining a steady time is more important...

text_block_list.text: ...Time? What?! How'd I forget thaaat?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sorry, I'll go again! Hyaaagh!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Finish in a minute! Finish in a minute!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Huh? I made it here in twenty seconds. Is
that too slow? Too fast?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Aaaaagh! I dunnooooo!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Let's see. The favorite for this race
couldn't win it. But why...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Ah! She didn't train enough! So if I try
extra hard in training, it's in the
bag! You
gotta train to gain!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: You don't think there might be another reason?

text_block_list.text: Another?! Like... like what?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
She went too close on the turn and got
surrounded by the pack.

text_block_list.text: Gaaaaah! You're totally right!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
It's not really something that needs saying,
but using her head's not
her strong point.
It's a bit of an obstacle in training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: But then...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock! Coming in!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Heya, Trainer! I watched tons of those
racing videos I borrowed
yesterday!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
And get this! I took notes on how I could
run better. You gotta take a
look!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's late, huh? I didn't mean to disturb
you.
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list:
No problem! I see you're at full speed like
always.

text_block_list.text: Nothing less!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I always pull out all the stops, but... I
dunno—I feel like I can pull way
more
stops than before!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I mean, you're serious about this, right?
About winning the Derby!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's what I promised, right?

text_block_list.text:
Right! I'm totally getting that vibe from
you! You've always felt that
way!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
My trainer really believes in me! It gives
me the energy to try harder
than I've ever
tried before!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Sooo... Thanks so muuuch!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The going was tough for a while there, but
with all the effort she's
putting in, I really
feel like she can figure this out.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I know she has loads of room to grow!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! What did you think about my
running ideas?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: They, well... Let's rethink them together!

text_block_list.text: That baaad?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: She can do it... I'm pretty sure!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
